Experimental_Design.Conditions: self-matching, self-mismatching, friend-matching, friend-mismatching, stranger-matching, stranger-mismatching (switch assignment: self->friend, friend->stranger, stranger->self)

Block_Structure.Practice_trials: 9 practice trials (one per condition) in Breaking; 6 practice trials in Association
Block_Structure.Trial_number: 648 formal trials per participant in Breaking (8 blocks x 81 = 9 conditions x 72) + 9 practice; Association: variable formal trials (until 6 consecutive correct per shape) + 6 practice

exp2.detail: Rebuilt 2026-08 stage 4 from the author's E-Merge aggregate CSV exports. 2026-09-01 txt-verified rebuild (v2): data source switched to the E-Merge txt exports in *_Raw/RawData_Exp2 (converted from edat2); author aggregate CSV verified value-by-value against the txt with 0 differences (2_Code/wang2016_verify/verify_merge_vs_csv.py); the CSV dropped the 9 breaking practice rows per participant (they exist in the txt) and the 6 association practice rows - both now included. Data: 25 participants (IDs 1-25; paper reports N=20 analyzed, 12 male, M=23.70, 18-30; data 25 = 10 male/15 female, M=23.52; no exclusion list published, data caliber kept - Issue 3). Two phases: Association (Part 1; 3AFC task, see Exp1 detail) and Breaking (Part 2; 9 practice + 8 blocks x 81; keys n/m). Clean: Label/Matching filled for Association (label = shape's assigned identity label; Matching = Matching); Block (1-8)/Trial (1-81) and CorrResponse added; Exp2 Clean labels lowercase (self/friend/stranger) as in the author export. Matching = rule B (new assignment: self->friend, friend->stranger, stranger->self), verified trial-by-trial against txt CorrectAnswer/YesNoResp (0 violations). On-screen label text was Chinese per participant; Label/Origin columns store English (lowercase). ACC 1/0 with no response -> NA. Paper statistics approximately reproduced (match-RT RM-ANOVA F=22.6 with 25 participants vs paper 17.35 with N=20; error F=4.75 vs 3.93; Issue 3).
